## Errors

Every non-2xx body is the TMF630 `Error`: `{"@type": "Error", "code", "reason", "message", "status"}` (`app/api/errors.py`), also for unknown routes, FastAPI's own validation errors and unhandled exceptions (500 says "internal error" only). Status codes: 400 malformed JSON, unknown or read-only attribute, bad query parameter; 404 unknown id or path; 405 unsupported method; 409 conflict with stored state; 415 wrong content type; 422 well-formed but invalid. 415 and 422 are ours: the TMF specs do not declare them. See [README.md](README.md#conventions).
